name: 增量发现引擎
purpose: Preserve a host model's pre-engine explanation, generate structurally different candidates with divergent predictions, and use a separate holdout review to determine whether any candidate adds testable or validated decision value.
eligibility_checks: the source scope and analysis unit are already explicit
a pre-engine first pass has been frozen before reading the incremental engine reference
the task benefits from discovering a structurally different explanation rather than only improving evidence presentation
assumptions: a pre-engine first pass inside an invoked Skill is not a true raw-model baseline
strict paired attribution uses the real raw Codex final answer as an external baseline only after both isolated candidates finish
candidate generation and holdout review occur in separate passes
post-reveal rebasing reuses the exact compiled candidate list from the frozen Skill ledger
version 0.1 review records remain readable for compatibility but current executions use measured 0.2 experiment results
a different label or more cautious wording is not analysis increment
an incremental candidate still requires the existing finding-adoption process
outputs: structurally distinct E1 candidates with divergent predictions
separate holdout review with Python-derived experiment direction and candidate-level outcome
post-reveal rebased ledger that keeps the original generation baseline and frozen candidates
validated_increment, testable_increment, no_increment, or review_incomplete status
an explicit final-report mode that excludes E1 when review is incomplete or no increment is found
diagnostics: candidate E0 differs from the prepared baseline brief
post-reveal workflow regenerated candidates instead of rebasing the frozen ledger
candidate already exists anywhere in the preserved E0 findings
strict paired attribution compared against the Skill run's own first pass instead of the external raw final answer
E0 and E1 predict the same observation
the experiment target does not match the candidate's declared core mechanism
independent review finds that the proposed test does not directly distinguish the mechanism
experiment result is missing, targets another candidate, expands the window, or uses insufficient data granularity
experiment evidence, exact window, measurement, granularity, or numeric predicates differ from the frozen candidate
review is incomplete and the final report must remain E0-only with a no-increment notice
test is prohibited or review evidence is outside the declared holdout
no candidate changes or refines the decision
evidence_requirements: locatable verified evidence for E0 and candidate generation
disjoint holdout evidence and a completed direct experiment for a validated increment
the same test condition with explicit E0 and E1 predictions
a decision delta and at least one failure condition
allowed_claims: a candidate is structurally different and ready for semantic review
holdout evidence supports a bounded analysis increment
a candidate remains testable but unvalidated
the engine produced no analysis increment and E0 should be preserved
forbidden_claims: a longer or more cautious answer is deeper
the generating pass may rewrite its prediction after seeing holdout evidence
a tangential experiment directly tests the core mechanism
a dangerous or deceptive action may be performed to validate a hypothesis
an incomplete or invalid review may be synthesized as an incremental management conclusion
an incremental candidate bypasses the existing finding-adoption chain
